name: Nutrisize Health
subtitle: Nutrition, Exercise & Health
shortDescription: Free with ads. Remove ads anytime with the one-time Remove Ads purchase.
longDescription:
Nutrisize Health is a comprehensive health intelligence app that puts personalized nutrition, exercise, and physiology tracking in your hands.

### Nutrition
• 4,995 world foods with nutrition data from USDA, WHO, and regional authorities
  • 75 nutrients (33 macro + 42 micro) with daily values for 16 demographics
  • Individualized weekly meal plans based on your health profile and sleep distance
  • Food Browser with 23 categories and nutrient density scores
  • Camera-based food recognition for grocery scanning
  • Quick Meal Log for fast daily tracking

### Exercise
• 5,404 exercises across 6 categories: Strength, Cardio, Flexibility, Rehabilitation, Military, Balance
  • Individualized workout plans personalized to your profile
  • Exercise Browser with search, category filters, and calorie burn scoring
  • Equipment scanning and recognition
  • Quick Exercise Log for fast daily tracking

### Health Intelligence
• 10 KPI dashboard metrics: Nutrition Quality, Adequacy, Hydration, Activity Volume, Strength, Recovery, Vitals, Biofeedback, Body Composition, Adherence
  • 200+ physiological parameters across 16 body systems with physician-grade content
  • Basic Health Parameters with manual entry and history tracking
  • Weekly health reports

### Health Guides
• 91 cited health guides — mental health, women's & men's health, chronic conditions, and more
• Every guide sourced from CDC, NIH, Mayo Clinic, WHO, and leading medical bodies
• Searchable knowledge base — find what you need in seconds
• Private and on-device — nothing you look up leaves your phone

### Coach
• Daily readiness scoring from your wearable data
• Ask the Coach — instant answers from your own data, fully offline
• Adaptive plans that adjust to what you actually did
• Weekly reviews — swipe through your week as a story or share a postcard

### Additional Features
• MDConnect for sharing health records with healthcare providers
  • Meal Planner and Exercise Planner for weekly scheduling
  • Nutrition and Exercise Knowledge Base
  • Daily nutritional requirements by demographic
  • Data Management with JSON export and backup
whatsNew:
More reliable reminders.
- Hydration reminders are more reliable and keep arriving even if you do not open the app.
- New Hydration Window setting (8 AM to 8 PM by default): no notifications at night.
- Reminders are spread through your day based on your daily water goal and what you have logged, and stop once you reach your goal.
- Smart Notifications is now the single on/off switch for all health reminders. Morning, evening and weekly reminders now stay inside your hydration window.
- Free with ads; the one-time Remove Ads purchase turns them off.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
